title: Geography: Rivers, Mountains, Landmarks
description: For geography beginners: identify major rivers, mountain ranges, peaks, and natural or cultural landmarks around the world. Boundary-dependent superlatives are qualified and alternative names are included where useful.

sources.name: UNESCO World Heritage List
sources.license: Public reference; original questions and answers
